structured.answer: I won't open anything yet; I'll ask my son or the bank. Psagot charges 0.07% to buy or sell (at least 2 ₪), 0.03% a quarter for holding, nothing monthly, and you need 10,000 ₪ to open. You can buy mutual funds and "קרן סל". There is nothing like a deposit, and the documents contradict what the ads promise.
